member.name: T:Inventoria.Models.Database.Database
member.summary:
Static helper class for managing the JSON database file.
Supports reading, writing, adding and removing items by id.
Supports nested attribute access via dot notation (e.g. "stock.quantity").

member.summary: Reads the database JSON file. Creates it if missing.
member.param: The file content, or empty string if the file is empty.
member.returns: True if content was read, false if file was empty or just created.

member.name: M:Inventoria.Models.Database.Database.TryLoadRoot(System.Text.Json.Nodes.JsonNode@)
member.summary: Loads and parses the database JSON file. Creates it if missing.
member.param: The parsed root node, or null if the file is empty.
member.returns: True if the file was loaded and parsed, false if empty or just created.

member.name: M:Inventoria.Models.Database.Database.ConvertToJsonNode(System.Object)
